newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt aims for lower debt, rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt aims for lower debt, rates.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the government aimed to reduce public debt and interest rates.

"These are the government's efforts: first of all to balance the Australian accounts, secondly to reduce interest rates, thirdly to reduce government debt and fourthly to give the young people of future Australia a go," Costello told parliament.
The government has argued that its economic policies will produce interest rates lower than they would have been without its reforms.
The Reserve Bank of Australia has cut official cash rates a total of 200 basis points, to 5.5 percent, in four equal cuts from July 1996 to May 23 this year.
The government aims to move the budget into underlying surplus -- excluding asset sales and state government debt repayments -- by the fiscal year to June 1999.
